digest.component_or_area: binding store and Jira Data Center reconciliation
propositions: A Jira issue's KEY changes when moved between projects, but its numeric ID remains immutable; bindings keyed on KEY become detached when the KEY changes and moved_issue_key table is not updated by third-party movers.
The absence probe silently orphans a live issue by reading a stale key as gone, retiring the binding even though the issue still exists under its numeric ID.
Recording the numeric ID alongside the KEY enables fallback resolution: when a KEY lookup 404s, retry by ID; on a hit with a different key, re-key the binding and update the reverse index atomically.
The fallback is additive and safe on legacy bindings with no recorded ID, requires no store migration, and does not change Cloud-facing semantics or existing key-taking method signatures.

Measurement on real DC 8.17.1 confirmed that GET /issue/{oldKey} after a project rename returns 200 with the NEW key in the body, proving the fix must defend against cases where moved_issue_key table is not updated and the stale key no longer resolves at all.
